notes: Patch UDPDataCheck so protocol 4 reuses the existing protocol 8 forward path.
Repurpose the currently unreferenced Confirmation method as a tiny bool helper that returns true for protocol 8 or protocol 4.
Replace the hard-coded FT8 payload length of 79 symbols with the already-captured payload[4] value so FT4 can forward its longer symbol stream instead of being truncated.

Patch SetDigitalData2 so the forwarded 5-byte header carries a second FT4/FT8 hint in byte[2] by mirroring the already-forwarded symbol count there. FT8 keeps its known-good 79-length path while FT4 no longer collapses into an all-zero mode field.

patches.name: udpdatacheck_ft4_forward_gate
patches.notes: Replace the protocol-8-only branch with a helper call that returns true for protocol 8 or protocol 4.

patches.name: confirmation_helper_repurpose
patches.notes: Turn Confirmation into a 16-byte helper: return (RecvProtocol == 4 || RecvProtocol == 8).

patches.name: udpdatacheck_variable_symbol_length
patches.notes: Reuse the existing payload[4] value (already stored into method arg2) so FT8 keeps 79 while FT4 can forward its larger symbol count.

patches.name: setdigitaldata2_mode_hint_from_length
patches.anchor_hint: SetDigitalData2 writes zero into header byte[2]
patches.notes: Mirror arg1 into header byte[2] while leaving byte[3] zero and byte[4] unchanged. This gives downstream code a visible FT4/FT8 discriminator without changing method size or the existing command 0x35 framing.
